row.prompt:
You are given an n × m grid (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 50). Each cell is either black (denoted by the character “B”) or white (denoted by “W”). A grid is called convex if, for any two black cells, there exists a path consisting only of side-adjacent black cells in which the direction changes at most once (i.e. the path is either a straight line or an “L”-shaped poly-line).

Input
The first line contains two integers n and m. Each of the next n lines contains a string of m characters, each character being “B” or “W”. It is guaranteed that there is at least one black cell.

Output
Print “YES” (without quotes) if the painted grid is convex; otherwise print “NO”.

Example
Input
3 4
WWBW
BWWW
WWWB

Output
NO
